title: Proactive regression detection and pause-trigger for staged model rollouts
author: Priya Sharma
release_notes: - Add proactive regression detector that pauses staged rollouts when quality regressions are detected. - New rollout policy option: pause_on_regression with configurable thresholds and sample windows. - Console: rollout timeline shows pause reasons and suggested mitigation steps.
description: Motivation: Staged rollouts (canary, staggered A/B, shadow-to-live) occasionally ship regressions that only show up in live traffic. This PR adds a lightweight, model-agnostic regression detector that monitors request-level signals and automatically pauses rollouts when user-impacting regressions cross configured thresholds. Goals: 1) catch regressions early without requiring heavyweight offline evals, 2) provide clear pause reasons and remediation hints in the Console, 3) be low-overhead and pluggable into existing rollout controller. Design summary: - A new regression_monitor service streams sampled request/response events and computes rolling metrics (error_rate, latency_p50/p95, output_quality_score via user-provided eval hooks). - Configurable detectors: threshold-based, delta-over-baseline, and median-shift for non-Gaussian signals. - A new rollout policy field pause_on_regression:{enabled, window_secs, min_samples, metric, threshold, sensitivity} applied per-rollout. - When a detector trips, the rollout controller transitions to PAUSED and annotates the rollout with a pause_reason and a suggested fallback (rollback, reduce_traffic, increase-sample). - Operator-visible actions in Console: resume, force-continue, promote-with-override (requires admin). - Telemetry: pause events emit rollout.pause.{reason,metric,delta} and attach example request IDs for investigations. Implementation highlights: - redwood/rollouts/regression_monitor.py: streaming aggregator using async batch windows, lightweight reservoir sampling for request contexts. - redwood/rollouts/controller.py: new state machine transitions (STAGED -> PAUSED), deterministic merkle of rollout config to prevent duplicate pause triggers. - console/rollouts_ui.tsx: new pause banner, explorer for sample traces, and a one-click run-local-eval button. - infra/k8s/rollout-crd.yaml: added pause_on_regression schema and RBAC annotation for pause/resume. - tests/rollouts/test_regression_detection.py: synthetic traffic harness and integration tests that simulate drift and noise. Migration notes: existing rollouts are opt-in; default pause_on_regression.enabled=false. Backwards compatibility preserved. Checklist: - [x] Regression detector core implementation - [x] Controller state transitions and safe-pausing - [x] Console UX for pause reason and traces - [x] Unit and integration tests for detector and controller - [x] Telemetry and SLI hooks - [x] Documentation pages and migration guide - [x] Performance microbench for monitor overhead (~1-3% CPU per router replica under 10k RPS) Commits: "add initial regression monitor and aggregator" (a1b2c3d), "wire monitor into rollout controller and state machine" (d4e5f6g), "console: add pause UX and trace explorer" (h7i8j9k), "tests: synthetic drift scenarios" (l0m1n2o), "docs: rollout pause and migration notes" (p3q4r5s). Files changed (high-level): redwood/rollouts/regression_monitor.py, redwood/rollouts/controller.py, console/rollouts_ui.tsx, infra/k8s/rollout-crd.yaml, tests/rollouts/test_regression_detection.py, docs/rollouts.md, scripts/perf/microbench_rollout_monitor.sh. Related: Linear ENG-5214 implements the detector telemetry, ENG-5230 ties the pause flow into Console UX. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-5214/proactive-regression-detection-design for design diagrams and metric definitions. CI notes: initial CI run failed unit tests due to race in histogram reset, fixed by using per-window bucket swapping and re-ran. All checks green on final run. Merge: squash and merge after approvals.

review_comments: Ethan Chen (2025-01-12): Nice incremental approach. Two nits: make the default window_secs smaller for canaries under 1% traffic, and add an escape hatch annotation to force-continue for emergency ops.
Priya Sharma (2025-01-13): Responding: lowered default window_secs to 60s for <1% traffic canaries, added rollout.metadata.annotations.force_continue=true as admin escape hatch.

Marcos Rivera (2025-01-15): Please add a short-circuit test to ensure pause isn't triggered by resolver-only errors (e.g., 502 from upstream) — we should only act on model-quality or latency regressions, not infra flakiness.
Priya Sharma (2025-01-16): Added filter for transient upstream errors: detector ignores error spikes when upstream-error-rate > 0.3 and includes guidance in docs.
Lena Volkova (2025-01-18): Approve after comment: ensure telemetry attaches <=10 example request IDs to avoid PII risk.
Priya Sharma (2025-01-19): Updated monitor sampling to redact user identifiers and limit sample size to 10, added unit test to assert redaction.
discussion_summary: Primary concern from reviewers was avoiding false positives from infra noise; addressed with upstream-error gating and min_samples guard
Performance overhead measured on perf harness: ~1-3% CPU at 10k RPS, memory overhead negligible
Console UX requested explicit admin override and clear pause reason; implemented both
post_merge_tasks: observability: add alert runbook for rollout.pause events
ops: add playbook entry for force-continue and sample collection
sdk: add rollout.pause reason to client SDKs and webhooks
notes_for_oncall: If a rollout becomes PAUSED and Operators request immediate resume, check rollout.pause.reason and telemetry. Use force-continue only if root-cause is confirmed and scatter-sample indicates no quality regression. If upstream-error gating is tripped, investigate network/edge proxies first.
